propositions: The context window check in pai_retry never executes on first requests because the filter proc(messages) only descends into ModelResponse objects, but first-request history is [ModelRequest], leaving _wire_keeps_response unreachable.

An oversized first request (3.6M chars vs 1M token window) passes through unchecked and surfaces to the provider as a 400 error that rebar misclassifies as LLMUnavailableError (provider outage) instead of a caller-fixable input problem.
The seam requires a request-side fit check using local token estimation (chars/4 calibration) to cover both first and retry requests uniformly before any provider call.
The chars/4 estimator must be chosen to keep enrich's window*2-char first-line bound admissible (chars/4 scores at ~window/2 tokens; chars/2 would fail closed, breaking AC#3).
Per-op bounds stay as first-line bounds with the seam as backstop; no existing bound is removed, and fail-closed ContextWindowExceededError matches errors.py's documented request-terms contract.
